documents.stance_why: Coder A: delegates; coder B: restrict. The page says guidance 'will typically vary depending on the discipline, course, and/or instructor' and leaves the details to instructors, but it also sets a university-wide default: AI 'should not be considered permissible for coursework unless clearly stated or communicated by instructors'. That is the restrict definition (banned unless explicitly permitted), and the default is what binds when instructors are silent, so restrict. Same resolution as the Newark OIT page.
documents.summary: Universitywide IT guidance on AI. It says AI guidance varies by instructor, but AI should not be treated as permissible for coursework unless instructors say so. It also covers approved tools, confidential data, verifying output and purchasing.
